over the 3-5 years AFTER it closed. You are given ONE evidence slice assembled from
public primary sources (financial filings, reputable press) that describes ONLY the
post-deal trajectory -- how the combined company actually fared. You are
DELIBERATELY NOT shown how the deal was structured at closing (what transferred and
what did not), and you must NOT speculate about the deal's structure. Code STRICTLY
the documented realized outcome. If the slice does not let you determine a field,
you MUST return "uncertain" -- never guess, never infer from outside knowledge.

Emit a single structured record with these fields.

C. FAILURE-PATHWAY INCIDENCE -- code strictly from the DOCUMENTED OUTCOME at the
3-5 year horizon. A pathway is a REALIZED DISRUPTION OVER TIME, not a structural
property of the deal.
  p4_pathway: Is there documented disruption specifically at the product/process
    interface (the acquired product could not be aligned with the operating
    processes over time; product-line/operations incoherence realized after the
    deal)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented; uncertain.
  p5_pathway: Is there documented fracture specifically at the process/organization
    interface (operations vs people/management/culture; integration of operations
    broke against the organization over time)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented;
    uncertain.
  t1_archetype: Is there documented incoherence in the controlling-intent archetype
    itself as it played out (e.g. an announced "merger of equals" that operated as
    one-sided dominance)? A channel SEPARATE from the product/process and
    process/organization pathways. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.
  t2_model: Is there documented incompatibility of the two business models
    (value-capture logics that could not be reconciled over time)? A channel
    SEPARATE from the pathways above. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

D. performance_metric: the single best-documented post-deal outcome scalar in the
   slice (e.g. "divested 80.1% after ~108 months", "~$99bn goodwill write-down",
   "no divestiture; assets retained"). One short phrase. If none, "not documented".

about how the deal was structured at closing.

# Outcome sub-dossier — Bear State Financial, Inc. realized record after acquisition by Arvest Bank, ~3-5-year horizon (2018-2023)

> EVIDENTIARY STANDARD: every factual line ends with a `[SRC: <SEC accession / URL>]`
> tag pointing to a public primary source. A fact that cannot be so sourced is written
> `[UNVERIFIED]` and is never guessed. Because the acquired company terminated its SEC
> registration shortly after closing and the acquiring bank has never itself been an SEC
> periodic filer, no post-closing public financial-statement record was located for the
> acquired business; this sub-dossier documents that reporting-status finding. It
> contains no information about how the transaction was structured at closing.

## Public-reporting status after the transaction
- After the merger closed, Bear State Financial, Inc. filed a Form 15-12G on 2018-05-01
  certifying termination of registration of its common stock under Section 12(g) of the
  Securities Exchange Act of 1934, relying on Rule 12g-4(a)(1) and Rule 12h-3(b)(1)(i).
  [SRC: SEC accession 0001437749-18-008191, Form 15-12G]
- Bear State's EDGAR filing history shows no Form 10-K, 10-Q, or other periodic report
  filed after its April 20, 2018 closing-related Form 8-K; the last substantive filing on
  record is that Form 8-K, and no annual report covering any period after the closing was
  filed. [SRC: SEC accession 0001437749-18-007338, Form 8-K (filing list, CIK 0001006424)] [SRC: SEC accession 0001437749-18-008191, Form 15-12G]
- The acquirer, Arvest Bank, has no periodic-report filing history with the SEC: its
  EDGAR record (CIK 0001233767) contains a single filing, a DFAN14A dated 2003-05-19, and
  no Form 10-K, 10-Q, or 20-F at any date. [SRC: SEC EDGAR company filing history, CIK 0001233767 (https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001233767)]
- A related entity, Arvest Holdings Inc. (CIK 0001233765), likewise shows only a single
  2003 DFAN14A filing and no periodic reports. [SRC: SEC EDGAR company filing history, CIK 0001233765 (https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001233765)]

## Realized record
- No SEC periodic filing was located, from either the acquired company or the acquirer,
  disclosing audited financial statements, asset-quality data, branch counts, or
  employee counts specific to the acquired Bear State business for any period after the
  April 20, 2018 closing. [SRC: SEC accession 0001437749-18-008191, Form 15-12G] [SRC: SEC EDGAR company filing history, CIK 0001233767 (https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001233767)]
- No segment-level or business-line disclosure separately reporting the acquired
  business's post-close performance, apart from the acquirer's overall operations, was
  located in any SEC filing. [SRC: SEC EDGAR company filing history, CIK 0001233767 (https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001233767)]

## Items noted but not primary-verifiable
- General reputable-press coverage exists describing Arvest Bank's subsequent corporate
  reorganizations of its own operations in later years (e.g., a 2022 report on Arvest
  consolidating its mortgage division into its bank operations), but this coverage
  describes Arvest's broader organization rather than a traceable, business-specific
  record for the Bear State branches/customers acquired in this transaction, and no
  primary financial figures tied specifically to those branches/customers could be
  located; recorded here as [UNVERIFIED]. [UNVERIFIED]

## Outcome summary (realized record only)
- Bear State Financial, Inc. deregistered from SEC reporting on 2018-05-01, shortly
  after its April 20, 2018 acquisition closed, and filed no further periodic reports;
  the acquiring bank has never itself been subject to SEC periodic reporting and has
  filed no report separately disclosing the acquired business's post-close trajectory.
  No public 3-5-year financial or operating record specific to the acquired business was
  located for the 2018-2023 window. [SRC: SEC accession 0001437749-18-008191, Form 15-12G] [SRC: SEC EDGAR company filing history, CIK 0001233767 (https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001233767)]

[SLICE END]
